title: Roast pepper, courgette and cod salad

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or a plain cupboard staple: potatoes, peppers, courgettes, onion, cod, rocket, capers, oil and spices.

supermarket.reason: Every item, including the cod fillets and rocket, is stocked by any mainstream UK supermarket at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a knife, board and one large roasting tray, and the technique is simple tray roasting.

works.reason: The staged roasting gives the potatoes 47 minutes and the vegetables about 30 at 220°C, and the cod gets 10 to 12, so everything should be cooked through; a cook will naturally turn the added vegetables in the tray oil.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is enough to halve the potatoes and chunk the peppers, courgettes and onion, and the 47 minutes of cooking matches 15 + 20 + 12 in the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, 'paprika' in step one plainly means the listed smoked paprika, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm tray-roast salad of peppers suits a late July evening, and the peppers lead both the title and the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: This is a proper dinner of fish, potatoes and plenty of vegetables that a family would happily eat again.
